name: Wikimedia Foundation
body: Preloaded HSTS, a content security policy starting at default-src 'self', and a sitemap per language. But the home page has no h1, and several About pages have two.
lesson: One h1 per page, naming what the page is. Screen-reader users often jump to it first.
summary: wikimediafoundation.org scores 85 out of 100 (B). 1 check fails now, 14 are at risk, and 22 pass. Fix first: 9 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 9 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /who-we-are/people/, /who-we-are/frequently-asked-questions/, /what-we-do/ and 4 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 18 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: 15 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /who-we-are/people/, /role/board/, /role/executive/, /role/staff/ and 11 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: 3 pages ask search engines not to index it
fix.fix: Remove noindex from pages that should be found, and keep it only on private or duplicate pages.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Matomo appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: 10 pages do not have exactly one h1
fix.fix: Give each page one h1 that names it.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
Language alternates point at each other
